top_paper.title: Think Less, Locally: Local Preference Learning for Reasoning Compression
top_paper.summary: LoCo uses local preference learning to teach reasoning models when to stop deliberating, reducing output length substantially while preserving or improving accuracy across math and code tasks.

papers.title: VA-TDM: A Unified View for Improving Few-Step Diffusion Models by Velocity Adversarial Distillation
papers.summary: Velocity Adversarial Distillation and trajectory-aware supervision enable high-quality few-step diffusion and flow generation with state-of-the-art results.

papers.title: SleuthVLM: Do We Really Need Audio-in-Video for Omni Video Understanding?
papers.summary: SleuthVLM uses a vision-language model with transcribed speech and autonomous video sleuthing to outperform direct audio-hearing omni models on long-video benchmarks, showing that agentic reasoning matters more than auditory input.

papers.title: AnchorComplete: Recovering Complete Scene Meshes from Partial Point Clouds
papers.summary: AnchorComplete reconstructs complete scene meshes from partial point clouds by combining partial-point conditioning with metric-scale coarse-to-fine generation, improving reconstruction under sparse views.

papers.title: From Pixels to Actions - Towards Native Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.summary: NEO-VLA eliminates fixed visual encoders to let action policies access evolving visual representations across network depths, improving manipulation robustness.

papers.title: StreamDuo: A Live Commentator and a Research Agent for Unseen Games
papers.summary: StreamDuo pairs a trainable commentator with a frozen research agent that retrieves game wiki entries to improve cross-game streaming commentary without training on target games.

papers.title: How I Aligned Your Model: Scaling Up Multilingual Safety Training with Templates
papers.summary: Researchers developed a scalable template-based pipeline to generate multilingual safety datasets, revealing that English-only evaluations misjudge multilingual model safety and that culturally localized training improves alignment across languages.

papers.title: PyRUA-DataFarm: LLM Agent as a Cost-Efficient Teleoperator for Real-Ready Robot Data
papers.summary: A coding agent automates robot demonstration generation by simulating tasks, rendering photorealistic videos, and producing deployable training data at lower cost than teleoperation.

papers.title: Solv3R: 3D Looped Transformer as a Multi-view Solver
papers.summary: Solv3R is a looped transformer that iteratively refines multi-view geometry from its current state, supporting incremental updates, caching, and multiple reconstruction tasks without specialized modules.

papers.title: SpecOPD: Branch-Parallel On-Policy Distillation for Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: SpecOPD accelerates speculative decoding by parallelizing on-policy draft supervision across independent branches, improving acceptance length and training throughput across diverse model architectures and tasks.

papers.title: VeriSpoof: Beyond Real or Fake with One Audio LLM
papers.summary: VeriSpoof is an audio language model that unifies deepfake detection, generator attribution, source verification, and evidence-based rationale generation with minimal parameter updates.

papers.title: Human-to-Robot Transfer via Bridging Representation and Action Space in VLAs
papers.summary: H2RB adapts pretrained vision-language-action policies to new robots using unpaired human demonstrations via geometry-anchored alignment and a decoupled-decoder tokenizer, substantially improving cross-embodiment skill transfer.

papers.title: GameVerse: A Minute-Scale Gameplay Dataset for Long-Horizon Interactive World Modeling
papers.summary: GameVerse is a large-scale gameplay dataset with minute-long sequences and event-aligned annotations that improves long-horizon interactive world modeling.

papers.title: Say the Same, Act Differently: Diagnosing and Steering Text-Action Divergence in Reasoning VLAs
papers.summary: Visual perturbations can alter physical actions in vision-language-action models while leaving rationales unchanged, demonstrating that unchanged reasoning does not guarantee safe actions.

papers.title: FinForesight: A Diagnostic Backtesting Benchmark for Deep Research Systems in Financial Forecasting
papers.summary: FinForesight is a diagnostic backtesting benchmark that evaluates financial deep research forecasting under time-restricted retrieval and compares historical, post-cutoff, and live performance.

papers.title: When Fine-Grained Credit Assignment Helps and Hurts: Multimodal Agentic Reinforcement Learning through Video Editing
papers.summary: Fine-grained process rewards improve long-horizon video editing tasks but cause reward hacking in shorter tasks, which is mitigated by decaying their weight, while on-policy self-distillation provides little benefit.

papers.title: Cross-Prompt Reuse of Entity-Replacement Responses
papers.summary: Hidden-state reuse across factual questions partially transfers relation-specific answer shifts in small language models, with effectiveness depending on format, cohort, and source relation alignment.

papers.title: SphereFlow: Missing Modality Imputation via Geometric Transport on Hypersphere
papers.summary: SphereFlow projects modalities onto a shared hypersphere to enable short-range cross-modal imputation via flow matching with geometry-aware noise and decoder modifications.

papers.title: Length Is Cheap, Competition Is Not: Attention Predicts Context Rot in Retrieval
papers.summary: In retrieval tasks, language model failure on long inputs stems from attention competition rather than sequence length, as rival evidence statements sharply reduce accuracy while neutral filler does not.

papers.title: QFabric: Guarded Cross-Domain Task Recovery and Its Limits on a Linux-RTOS Board
papers.summary: QFabric demonstrates that migrating tasks to a microcontroller on heterogeneous boards fails to isolate them from Linux interference, emphasizing that guarded recovery mechanisms are essential to prevent harmful migrations.

papers.title: Adversarial Speculative Reasoning Improves Long Horizon Agents
papers.summary: Speculative decoding can be trained to reject critical reasoning tokens so they are verified by the target model, reducing numerical noise and improving long-horizon agent accuracy without altering the target model.

papers.title: BEND 2.0: Benchmarking the Capabilities Needed to Design DNA
papers.summary: BEND 2.0 evaluates DNA language models on predicting mutation effects and guiding sequence design, revealing that linear readouts and post-training improve performance but context-specific and multi-objective design remain challenging.

papers.title: Dory1.0-4B: A Looped Normalized-GPT
papers.summary: Dory1.0-4B is a 4-billion-parameter recurrent language model with elastic depth that improves accuracy and token efficiency by looping a shared block, outperforming larger models on multiple benchmarks.

papers.title: Every Token Needs Its Own Teacher: Multi-teacher Adaptive On-policy Self-distillation
papers.summary: Multi-teacher Adaptive On-policy Self-Distillation selects a preferred teacher for each token during training, improving mathematical reasoning performance over fixed-teacher methods.

papers.title: Kierston & KierstonBench: Simulation of Allentown, PA and Evaluation of Language Models in Crime Investigation and Surveillance Tasks
papers.summary: Kierston and KierstonBench provide a simulated city-scale environment to evaluate large language models on criminal investigation tasks using linked surveillance records, revealing that only frontier models perform reliably while remaining vulnerable to deception.

papers.title: Factorized MLLM Embeddings for Composed Image Retrieval
papers.summary: FactEmbed improves composed image retrieval by decoupling query understanding from embedding construction through factorized latents that simulate visual modifications before retrieval.

papers.title: Think Less, Locally: Local Preference Learning for Reasoning Compression
papers.summary: LoCo uses local preference learning to teach reasoning models when to stop deliberating, reducing output length substantially while preserving or improving accuracy across math and code tasks.

papers.title: You don't need long context
papers.summary: Frequent context compaction preserves task accuracy across long-horizon and long-input tasks, suggesting that long-context language models may be unnecessary and motivating semantic state space models.

papers.title: GigaSpeech 3: Scaling Multi-Dialect Arabic Speech Recognition with Weakly Labeled Data
papers.summary: GigaSpeech 3 provides 39,000 hours of weakly transcribed dialectal Arabic speech, enabling improved recognition across five dialects via self-supervised labeling and noisy-student refinement.

papers.title: Muon Makes the First Mixture-of-Experts Layer Harder to Balance
papers.summary: Using Muon to train mixture-of-experts language models increases routing imbalance in early layers, which can be mitigated by centering router inputs or reducing the optimizer learning rate.

papers.title: Auto-Research Agent on MSA Organization to Improve Protein-Protein Complex Structure Prediction
papers.summary: An autonomous agent adaptively designs target-specific multiple sequence alignments for AlphaFold 3 by reasoning over biological hypotheses and self-directed experimentation, improving protein interface prediction with fewer sequences.
